scientific_scope: 150M short-continuation allocation signal, not a 200-step replication, practical-efficiency result, or dense-fewer victory

model.freshness: bodies were used in earlier original-paper experiments but not in low-max-abs discovery or selection

program.name: low_max_abs
program.execution: exact per-layer Top-B; padding excluded; current on-policy features; gather/scatter; no router learning

continuation.learning_rate_basis: end-of-cosine continuation rather than restarting at the original peak 0.0001
continuation.optimizer: AdamW, newly initialized state because checkpoints contain body parameters only

evaluation.held_out_status: newly generated and not used in prior experiments
evaluation.primary: low_max_abs minus paired random sparse held-out loss at step 50 on each body
evaluation.secondary: sparse accuracy, dense held-out evaluation, and change from the initial sparse evaluation

execution_order: body 0 random, body 0 low_max_abs, body 1 random, body 1 low_max_abs; sequential MPS only

decision_rules.positive_scale_signal: low_max_abs has lower final sparse loss than random on both bodies with no protocol change
decision_rules.failed_scale_pilot: any final paired loss difference is nonnegative; no score, budget, seed, or learning-rate changes afterward
decision_rules.useful_continuation_check: report whether final sparse loss improves from step 0 rather than relying only on relative allocation differences
decision_rules.no_level_3: no practical or dense-fewer claim from this fixed-budget pilot

prohibited: using the incorrect tagged-v1 smoke results as scientific evidence
treating one-step engineering smokes as scale results
optional extension to 100 or 200 steps based on observed outcomes
post-hoc learning-rate, body-seed, held-out-seed, or budget tuning
using MPS-only FLOP totals for practical accounting

engineering_restart_2026_11_15.reason: The background wall-clock timeout stopped the original process after laptop sleep; PID 72121 was no longer running.
engineering_restart_2026_11_15.interrupted_arm_action: Restart from step 0 with identical settings because only metrics, not model or optimizer state, were saved. The partial arm is not scientific evidence.
engineering_restart_2026_11_15.resume_guard: Reuse only completed arms with exactly matching configuration, checkpoint, arm, body seed, online seed, budget, and final step.
engineering_restart_2026_11_15.timeout_policy: No background wall-clock timeout; computation still requires the Mac to be awake.

compute_estimate.basis: four 50-step arms plus three dense-and-sparse evaluations per arm
